title: Session Failure Audit - update uiux tool call names

steps.title: 1. Extract Operations
steps.body: Pull all 195 tool calls from session 60322ed9 via get_recent_chat_history and evidence JSON

parallel.title: 2a. Group Failures by Tool
parallel.body: Count failures per tool name: edit_project_files, execute_command, web_search, get_recent_chat_history, search_project_content

parallel.title: 2b. Group Failures by Error Code
parallel.body: Classify by error type: tool_infra, stale_content, invalid_args, match_error, model_mistake, nonzero_exit, sandbox_timeout, invalid_cmd

parallel.title: 3a. Infra vs Legit Failures
parallel.body: Separate tool infrastructure failures (network, timeout, auth) from legitimate test/build failures (assertion, compile, lint)

parallel.title: 3b. Edit Failure Root Causes
parallel.body: For each edit_project_files failure: stale_content_hash, invalid_args, fuzzy_match_error, or model_generated_wrong_patch

parallel.title: 4a. Plan Failures
parallel.body: Check update_plan calls: ownership_mismatch, revision_conflict (STALE_PLAN), invalid_transition (new_task vs supersede)

parallel.title: 4b. Shell Failures
parallel.body: Analyze execute_command: exit_code≠0, sandbox_restriction (no net/X11), timeout_ms exceeded, invalid_syntax

steps.title: 5. Repeated Error Patterns
steps.body: Find operations retried without adaptation: same tool, same args, same error → model didn't learn from feedback

parallel.title: 6a. Pre-Prompt Failures
parallel.body: Failure rate & types before additional user prompts (turns 1-N)

parallel.title: 6b. Post-Prompt Failures
parallel.body: Failure rate & types after additional prompts — did guidance reduce infra vs legit failures?

steps.title: 7. Smallest Proven Defects
steps.body: Report minimal reproducible bugs: e.g., get_recent_chat_history returns empty on session_boundary, web_search rejects quoted phrases >500 chars

steps.title: 8. Audit Report
steps.body: Emit findings as structured JSON + markdown summary — no code changes, read-only
